description: This file provides a helper function to override certain URL endpoints for authentication-related API calls. It defines specific URL patterns to route certain auth endpoints to an external domain, ensuring the proper handling of auth flows that require external domains while maintaining default URL logic for other endpoints.

methods.name: resolveAuthEndpointUrl(path, baseUrl)
methods.description: Generates and returns a full URL for API requests, applying specific overrides for certain auth-related endpoints to route them to an external domain instead of the base URL.
